claim: OUT-007-TASK-002 exposes bounded transport-free Git-backed completed-history list, search, and show queries through PortfolioApplication with verified identities, opaque source-bound cursors, and typed fail-closed diagnostics.
evidence: Introducing target commits are derived through Git history and reverified against the current completion package tree before acceptance.
Package identity verifies actual manifest bytes, authored digests verify actual authority/design/intent blobs, and authority identity is cross-checked across separate artifacts.
Opaque cursors bind source target commit and normalized query digest, preventing replay across target or query context.
Malformed completed roots, unsafe child names, unexpected files, stale ancestry, and digest mismatch fail through typed diagnostics without ref mutation.
Frozen bounded records expose only identities, stable path, digest, target commits, title, and semantic summary; tests exclude authored and runtime bodies.
PortfolioApplication exposes exactly list_completed_changes, search_completed_changes, and show_completed_change, while active projections remain separate.
Independent focused validation passed 49 tests on exact commit 25213bdbf12f9ffc2b4b9fe565e2b2c1f25b01f5; the full Kanban suite passed 163 tests, and Ruff and diagnostics are clean.
